metadata.description: Every Claude skill I use, in one marketplace.

plugins.name: brand-voice
plugins.description: Brand Voice transforms scattered brand materials into enforceable AI guardrails — automatically. It searches across Notion, Google Drive, Confluence, Gong, Slack, and meeting transcripts to distill your strongest brand signals into a single source of truth, then applies them to every piece of AI-gen

plugins.name: cowork-plugin-management
plugins.description: Create, customize, and manage plugins tailored to your organization's tools and workflows. Configure MCP servers, adjust plugin behavior, and adapt templates to match how your team works.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Write SQL, explore datasets, and generate insights faster. Build visualizations and dashboards, and turn raw data into clear stories for stakeholders.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Accelerate design workflows — critique, design system management, UX writing, accessibility audits, research synthesis, and dev handoff. From exploration to pixel-perfect specs.

plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Core Anthropic skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx, file reading, frontend design...).

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Streamline engineering workflows — standups, code review, architecture decisions, incident response, and technical documentation. Works with your existing tools or standalone.

plugins.name: example-skills
plugins.description: Anthropic example skills available in Claude (skill-creator, mcp-builder, canvas-design...).

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Create content, plan campaigns, and analyze performance across marketing channels. Maintain brand voice consistency, track competitors, and report on what's working.

plugins.name: my-skills
plugins.description: Personal skills from my claude.ai account and ~/.claude/skills on my machines.

plugins.name: system-tools
plugins.description: Tooling skills that ship with the environment (playwright, desktop computer use...).

plugins.name: zapier
plugins.description: Connect 9,000+ apps to your AI workflow. Discover, enable, and execute Zapier actions directly from your client.
